I bid thee farewell, cruel longing and inscrutable fate, I know not the masters you serve. I beseech thee, lord, to let your whiles blossom in this heart - I grant you, as only I may do, the throne of this soul. I find that you were there all along, veiled in this clemency I could not afford myself. How gracious of you to wait for me to come to my senses. How mercifully you take me, and show me I am whole, beyond all sense.
